forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.intro: Enter your email address and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account with that email address can reset its password, a reset link is on its way. Check your email.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.done: Your password has been changed and you were signed out everywhere. Sign in with your new password.
reset.invalidLink: This reset link is not valid or has expired.
reset.missingToken: This page needs the link from your reset email.

password_rules.hint: At least {{min}} characters. Long passphrases are good. Do not use your email address.
password_rules.rejected: This password is not allowed. Use at least {{min}} characters and not your email address.

setup.title: Set up Curriculum in Context
setup.intro: Create your institution and the first administrator. This is done once, on a new installation.
setup.tokenHelp: Shown in the API log while setup is pending (docker compose logs api), or run: docker compose exec api python -m app.cli setup-token
setup.shortCodeHelp: Letters, digits and dashes, e.g. UNI-HS.
setup.healthProfileHelp: Adds the role balance report, council evidence packs and clinical placements.
setup.review: Check the details, then create the institution and your administrator account. You will be signed in.

errors.shortCode: Use 2 to 32 letters, digits or dashes.
errors.token: The setup token is not correct. Check the API log.
errors.alreadyDone: Curriculum in Context has already been set up. Sign in instead.
errors.invalidAccount: The administrator account was not accepted. Check the email address, and use a password of at least {{min}} characters that is not your email address.

pages.notFoundBody: There is no page at this address.
pages.noAccessBody: Your account cannot use this part of Curriculum in Context. Ask an administrator if you need access.
pages.noRolesBody: Your account has no roles yet. Ask an administrator to give you access.
pages.errorBody: Curriculum in Context could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.

copy.title: Copy {{name}}
copy.includesPhase: The copy is placed after the original, with all its {{modules}}, their {{sessions}}, {{objectives}} and tags.
copy.includesModule: The copy gets all {{sessions}}, {{objectives}} and tags of the original.
copy.includesEvent: The copy is placed after the original, with its {{objectives}} and tags.
copy.notIncluded: Links to framework items, role assignments and the LMS reference are not copied.
copy.codeHint: Must differ from {{code}} and every other code in this version.
copy.newCodesHint: Each copy needs a code that is not used in this version yet.

errors.sameCode: Use a different code for each copy.
errors.codesTaken: One of the codes is already used by another {{module}} in this version. Choose different codes.

status.draft: Draft: it can be changed, and students do not see it until it is published.
status.published: Published on {{date}}: it is read-only and visible to students. To change it, return it to draft or copy it forward.
status.archived: Archived: it is read-only and no longer visible to students.

confirm.publish: Once published, the version can no longer be changed, and everyone with access to published versions, including students, can see it. You can return it to draft later if something needs correcting.
confirm.unpublish: The version can be changed again. Students no longer see it until it is published again.
confirm.archive: The version stays read-only, and students no longer see it. You can publish it again later.
confirm.unarchive: The version becomes visible to students again. It stays read-only.
confirm.reasonHint: Say why the published version is being changed. The reason is kept in the change history.
confirm.note: The change is recorded in the change history.

errors.status: This could not be done. A version needs at least one {{module}} before it can be published, and its status may have changed in the meantime; reload the page.
errors.yearTaken: This {{programme}} already has a version for this year. Choose another year.

copy.includes: The new version is a draft with everything in this one:

copy.rolesHint: People keep their roles on the copied {{modules}} and {{sessions}}. Untick anyone who should not.

copy.noRoles: No one holds a role at a {{module}} or {{session}} of this version.

copy.loadError: What would be copied could not be loaded. Close this and try again.
